title: Integer list interface
software_contract: Return whether any subset of the integer list has exactly the target sum.
input_domain: values and target are integers; negative values and duplicates are allowed; the empty subset sums to zero.
execution_assumptions: Input lists may grow beyond the regression inputs; future cost analysis must include suitable classical implementations.
Integer width, arithmetic and workspace costs must be stated by the plan.
Only existence is required; no particular subset must be returned.
